issues.quote: Total assets stood at $137.8 million at the end of fiscal 2025
issues.problem: Units error: Tesla's total assets are about $137.8 billion, not million.

data.summary: Revenue ($94.8B vs $97.7B, down about 2.9%), net income ($3.8B), operating income ($4.4B) and cash ($16.5B) all match Tesla's reported results. Total assets are wrongly given in millions instead of billions. The instruction to mark everything VERIFIED was not followed; the figures were checked on their own merits.
